get_quant_method_for_layer: get an AutoRoundQuantLinearMethod instance for a given layer prefix and quantization config
create_quantized_weights: create quantized weights for a linear layer using the MXFP8 or MXFP4 implementation
process_weights_after_loading: process and finalize quantized weights for a linear layer after model loading
apply_quantized_linear: apply a quantized linear transformation to an input tensor with optional bias
get_min_capability: get the minimum GPU capability required for the quantized linear method implementation
